title: Whole Empty H Press and Bearing Preparation Bay
description: One static press-maintenance equipment preparation bay, one scene zero new reusable models. The whole original floor-standing pierced H-frame press occupies the left station with both long feet, five-port uprights, pinned open bed rails, fixed blunt ram, side pump and complete hose intact. Its work interval remains entirely empty. A separate complete worktable at right supports the entire fixed raised-cap bearing housing and one complete three-hook spindle puller, each on its own original bottom patches and with a visible tabletop gap. The cap stays on its original studs; the puller remains empty and is not fitted around the housing or installed under the press. Every original unit-scale geometry buffer, local normal, internal hierarchy and full opaque PBR dictionary is preserved. Only a finite low floor and whole translations are new. This ordinary maintenance preparation workspace differs in complete equipment and independent floor/bench arrangement from the twin raised forming tools and front brake station, or the knee mill with a separately raised index head. No workpiece, pressing, extraction, shaft fit, disassembly sequence, machinery compatibility, force, load, rated access, manufacturing or workplace-safety capability. Small tabletop details are subordinate at scene scale. Rigging animation interaction not made.
